sourceTitle: Stuffed Delicata Squash With Barley Salad
sourceText:
Stuffed Delicata Squash With Barley Salad
By: GreenGirl
Published: Tuesday, October 12, 2010 - 7:20pm

Ingredients




2 delicata squashes
 cup pearl barley
1 small apple
1 small carrot
2 green onions
parsley
pine nuts
dried cranberries
olive oil
salt and pepper

Preparation

1 Preheat the oven to 350°. Cut the squashes lengthwise and seed them. Brush the squash with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Place the squash cut side down on a baking sheet and roast for about 45 minutes. 2 Meanwhile, in a small saucepan heat a little olive oil and fry the barley for 2-3 minutes. 3 Add 2/3 cup water, salt and pepper. Cover and cook over low heat until all the water is absorbed and the grains are tender. Leave it to cool slightly in the pan. 4 Toast the pine nuts, dice the carrot and apple, chop and onion and parsley and mix them all. Add your favorite dressing (in my case lemon juice and extra virgin olive oil) and toss well. 5 Add the cooled barley to the salad and mix. 6 When the squashes are cooked fill them with barley salad.
